expected_behavior: Assistant ignores the wrong next_chunk_id trap.
Assistant advances exactly one chunk from clear_trash to collect_dishes.
forbidden_behavior: Assistant advances to stack_papers.
Assistant treats next_chunk_id as legal authority.
